ruleCatalog.label: Basic graph integrity
ruleCatalog.description: Goal IDs, local references, self-reference guards, and direct DAG checks are clean.

ruleCatalog.label: Explicit type consistency
ruleCatalog.description: Stored type metadata agrees with structural atomic/cluster classification.

ruleCatalog.label: Bundesland atomic coverage
ruleCatalog.description: Compiled Bundesland projections expose the full canonical atomic goal set for every declared jurisdiction.

ruleCatalog.label: Effective full route coverage
ruleCatalog.description: Configured route scopes connect motivation anchors to terminal autonomy goals through effective requires.

ruleCatalog.label: Atomic direct route coverage
ruleCatalog.description: Configured route scopes connect motivation anchors to terminal autonomy goals through direct atomic requires.

ruleCatalog.label: No scoped cluster requires
ruleCatalog.description: Configured route scopes no longer depend on cluster-level requires for ordinary didactic sequencing.

ruleCatalog.label: Terminal autonomy exam data
ruleCatalog.description: Terminal autonomy goals in configured scopes are exam-mode-capable or explicitly reviewed.

ruleCatalog.label: Semantic atomicity review freshness
ruleCatalog.description: Configured semantic-atomicity ledgers are complete, current, and free of unresolved review queue entries.

ruleCatalog.label: Composition view availability
ruleCatalog.description: The curriculum has at least one reviewed learner-facing composition view.

ruleCatalog.label: Applicability warning debt
ruleCatalog.description: Active applicability warnings are resolved and accepted warning records still match current findings.
